Create a misty industrial settlement of eight to ten rusted structures in a loose oval around an empty yard. Anchor one end with a tiered furnace and surround the rest with cylindrical workshops and chimney towers. Add sparse cables, smoke, warm glows, and boulders on a dark plateau above fog-filled ravines.
